text:
Predicates:
Beethoven(x) ::: x is Beethoven.
MusicPiece(x) ::: x is a music piece.
Write(x, y) ::: x writes y.
PremieredBy(x, y) ::: x is the premiere group of y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
ViennaMusicSociety(x) ::: x is the Vienna Music Society.
Symphony9 ::: Symphony No. 9.
Premises:
MusicPiece(Symphony9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Write(Beethoven, Symphony9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
PremieredBy(ViennaMusicSociety, Symphony9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(ViennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(Beethoven, ViennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(x) ∧ ∃y (Leads(y, x) ∧ Conductor(y)) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.
Conclusion:
¬Conductor(Beethoven) ::: Beethoven is not a conductor.
